settings.title: Rejoins
settings.intro: Tracks power-cycle / rejoin events for devices with rejoin detection (MINI-ZBD, ZBMINI-R2).
settings.reset_rejoins_confirmation: Reset the rejoin counters for all devices? This cannot be undone.
settings.footnote: A rejoin is detected from a paired 0xFC11 + 0x0006 boot-dump pattern right after the device reconnects — see MINI-ZBD/ZBMINIR2 device.js.
